**PotentialWax 1.7.0**

- **MANUAL page.** The plugin's manual is now on the MPC's screen: tap **MANUAL**, then the page buttons along the top (what it does, the controls, how it works with the other PotentialSuite plugins, and good-to-know notes). The full PotentialSuite manual is on the [PotentialSuite page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins).
- One parameter was added at the end of the list (Manual Page); saved projects open as before. Sound and controls are unchanged.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWax-1.7.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWax-1.7.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialWax-1.7.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialWax-1.7.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
